comment: Global server-side metadata corrections applied on top of manifest env/gameVersions, for every pack. Same role as itzg's modrinth-exclude-include.json. Every entry carries the loader-error evidence that justified it. Entries are data, never code branches. `unlessPresent`: exclusion applies only when no file in the pack matches that token — use it when a mod breaks only because its dependency is absent.
